articles._summary: WTI crude has now fully wiped out its war premium. Oil is also down more than 20% on the month, on pace for its worst monthly performance since March 2020. Saudi Arabia resumed loading tankers at Ras Tanura, and Persian Gulf exports recovered to roughly 75% of prewar levels, according to Goldman Sachs estimates. On Friday, President Donald Trump said Iran had fired four “one-way attack drones” at ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz, calling it “a foolish violation of our ceasefire agreement.” Markets shrugged.

articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: Software ETFs Are Finally Catching An AI Tailwind
articles.summary: Software ETFs surged while semiconductor funds fell as investors broadened the AI trade beyond chipmakers to enterprise software companies.
articles._summary: The artificial intelligence trade may be entering its next phase—and ETF investors are taking notice. IGV’s gains were fueled by a broad rally across enterprise software names. The strong performance comes after software stocks spent much of the AI boom trailing semiconductor companies. Investors had largely favored chipmakers, betting they would be the primary beneficiaries of surging demand for AI infrastructure, while concerns persisted that generative AI could disrupt parts of the software industry.
articles._zh_headline: 软件 ETF 终于迎来了人工智能的顺风车
articles._zh_summary: 人工智能行业可能正在进入下一阶段——ETF 投资者正在注意到这一点。 IGV 的上涨得益于企业软件品牌的广泛上涨。在人工智能繁荣时期，软件股的大部分表现落后于半导体公司，之后软件股表现强劲。投资者在很大程度上青睐芯片制造商，认为他们将成为人工智能基础设施需求激增的主要受益者，但人们仍然担心生成式人工智能可能会扰乱部分软件行业。
